facts: The authors propose to incorporate a priori geometric constraints in a 3-D stereo reconstruction scheme.
The proposed incorporation of a priori geometric constraints is intended to cope with cases where image information alone is not sufficient to accurately recover 3-D shape.
Image information alone is not sufficient to accurately recover 3-D shape in many cases.
The approach is based on the iterative deformation of a 3-D surface mesh.
The approach aims to minimize an objective function.
The method combines anisotropic meshing with a non-quadratic approach to regularization.
This combination enables obtaining satisfactory reconstruction results.
The satisfactory reconstruction results are obtained using triangulations with few vertices.
Structural or numerical constraints can be added locally to the reconstruction process.
The constraints are added through a constrained optimization scheme.
Structural or numerical constraints improve the reconstruction results.
Structural or numerical constraints enforce consistency of the reconstruction results with a priori knowledge about object shape.
Differential features have strong description properties.
Differential features have strong modeling properties.
Differential features can be efficiently used as constraints for 3-D reconstruction.
